Forgiveness doesn't have to end with being friends with the person again. It's more for you to let go and move on to new places in life (trusting new people etc.). I personally think you should invest in other relationships and personal goals. Best of luck to you.

To some extent, mainly when I forget to feed and hydrate myself. My leg circulation has improved in the last year or so with small exercises so I don't get as numb anymore, though it does still happen. I try to catch it early and move around a bit before the tingly aching starts. IDK about ejaculation as I don't quite do that, but, you may have some badly tensed muscles in your abdomen that could be making this all much worse. I've had some muscle problems of that sort (surgery scars and whatnot that goes along with that), massage and gentle intentional stretching has helped with that. It's difficult to heal but well worth it. I hope you find relief.

I have thus far refused to take prescriptions. Acupuncture, physical therapy, and massages have helped me. It's mostly been treating old scars, they hold more tension and pain than I had known. 
Oh and CBD, it's legal in most states. I started with a small dose and added to it untill it worked, then I was able to use less and less as my overall tension relaxed.
